tableLines.line: 📓 Journal: Alejandra taught Ruth Gossip Network.
📖 LEARNED: Gossip Network (Level 1). You hear things. People tell you things. You remember who told you what.
"Your understanding is... deepening! We can see it! Like watching a seed decide to be a tree! Beautiful! Profitable!"
(The pods need an answer. Speak for them — it will cost you — or let the segment play.)
👂 Overheard — David (to Tanisha): "Aki's story has a fresh coat of paint." David taps the table. "Scrape it off and you get from Hokkaido, Japan. Just don't scrape it in front of them."
The moment passed. Nobody mentions the pods today. A few people notice that nobody mentions them.
You came back bloody. Nobody asks. Someone saves you the good seat by the fire.

✨ Ability gained: Fusion Reactor (L1). The System installs your fusion pellet — properly, inside you. You never need to eat again: the pellet covers your metabolism, and your strikes and abilities burn with a steady reactor fire (1.25x, always on). One reactor per world, and it never comes out: not unslotted, not un-taught, not surrendered. Death is the only uninstall. But the hunger is gone, and

The little star inside Ji goes quiet — and wakes up inside Alejandra. Ji never got hungry while the village did, so the pellet moved to hungrier hands: Alejandra will never be hungry again while it hums, and Ji is hungry again, for the first time in a long while. The table can hear a feast again.
📓 Codex: you've heard of Harvest Table. Someone, somewhere, can do this. Now you know its name.
◈ THE SYSTEM has been watching Sung — Combat 1. Three offers; they took Harvest Table. Earned, chosen. (harvest_table: villager level-up)
📓 Codex: Sung chose Harvest Table (harvest_table) at Combat 1.
The village feels it before they understand it: Haven isn't just Haven anymore. Tanisha speaks at Emberhold's table now — earned, not appointed. And the other fire is watching what Haven does FIRST.
